prompt:
Original Taiwanese game art for "Tainan Gazetteer" (府城夜巡地圖), set in Tainan around 1930.
Style: handmade layered paper sculpture (紙雕 / kirie), the same for buildings, trees, plants,
fences, ground tiles, icons and props. Every shape is a piece of cut paper: visible paper fibres,
slightly soft hand-cut edges, pieces overlapping in shallow layers with small soft contact shadows
where one sheet sits on another. Colour is printed on the paper: clearly visible risograph /
stencil print grain and uneven ink density across every flat area, never a clean digital fill.
Weathering is welcome: irregular faded patches, not neat squares.
Details are built from few, large cut pieces (roof tiles, bricks, window frames, leaves, petals,
stones, planks), not painted lines and not crowded tiny patterns. Plants are natural and
asymmetric.
Colour: follow the real object, then mute it: pale, slightly greyed, warm. Typical tones: warm
cream, pale brick red, coral, sage and grey-green, mustard, indigo, wood brown, stone grey.
No saturated red-against-green contrast.
Buildings: strictly frontal elevation, no perspective, three or four flat paper layers.
Do NOT make: a 3D render or clay/plastic model, smooth bevelled relief, realistic or painterly
illustration, photo textures, thick foam layers, glow, glossy highlights, black outline strokes,
smooth gradients, depth of field.
Output: generated natively on a fully TRANSPARENT background (real alpha including enclosed
holes, no backdrop, no glow, no chroma-key colour, no coloured fringe), every object complete
and separated by clear transparent gutters, no ground, no base, no cast shadow outside the
object, no text, no captions, no logos.

Use case: stylized-concept. Draw the game sprite sheet for request 25-stepping-stones. Image 1 (stoneFill.png) is the approved paper-fibre, print-grain and muted colour reference only. Images 2 and 3 (stonepath-1.jpg and stonepath-2.jpg) inform naturally varied stone silhouettes only. Create exactly eight separate stepping stones, one centred in each of eight equal invisible cells, four columns and two rows across a wide landscape canvas. These are separate sprites for assembling a path in-game. No visible grid, no text, no ground, no grey backdrop, no checkerboard, no glow or exterior shadow; all space outside each cutout is fully transparent.

Top row left to right: stone1 large warm grey rounded irregular polygon; stone2 medium ivory asymmetrical oval; stone3 large sage-grey irregular stone with a small notch and one tiny cut-paper grass leaf attached at the edge; stone4 small warm grey flattened irregular pebble.
Bottom row left to right: stone5 medium pale green-grey elongated slab; stone6 large warm ivory broad irregular slab with two tiny cut-paper grass leaves attached at the edge; stone7 small ivory compact asymmetric polygon; stone8 medium warm grey flattened oblong slab with one tiny cut-paper grass leaf attached at the edge.
Large stones occupy ~85% of their cell width, medium ~65%, small ~40%. Exactly three large, three medium, two small. Vary all silhouettes and subtly vary all tones. Top-down with a very thin darker paper layer showing just at the front edge. Clearly visible paper fibres, uneven stencil-print grain and lightly faded patches matching the fill tile. Leave transparent gutters across every internal cell boundary and around the sheet; every stone and attached leaf stays entirely within its own cell.

Technical priority: output clean sprite alpha. Populate a strict 4-by-2 equal-cell grid with mathematically uniform cell centres. For a 1800 by 900 image, x centres are approximately 225, 675, 1125, 1575 and y centres are 225 and 675. Relative stone widths by row are 85%, 65%, 85%, 40% and 65%, 85%, 40%, 65%. Keep the canvas empty between the cutouts, with alpha exactly zero throughout the empty regions. Sharp individual cut-paper silhouettes with clean antialiasing, zero exterior haze, zero speckling in the empty space. All texture is contained inside the stone and attached grass silhouettes. Each grassy stone has only one small grass attachment with one or two individual leaves.
notes: 內建 imagegen 原生透明輸出。public/art/tiles/stoneFill.png 參考紙質與色調，art-source/refs/stonepath-1.jpg、art-source/refs/stonepath-2.jpg 參考輪廓。交付時逐格置中、按比例縮放，清除極低 alpha 的雜點。
